title: Rochdale Online has closed: where to find Rochdale news and notices now
seo_title: Rochdale Online: what happened and where to go now
description: Rochdale Online ceased trading in March 2025. What happened, why its old web address is not safe to use, and where to find Rochdale news, death notices and community listings now.
lede: Rochdale Online, the borough's long-running independent news website, ceased trading in March 2025 after 27 years. Here is what happened, and where to find what it used to provide.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.html:
Rochdale Online was founded in June 1998. In March 2025 the company ceased trading and appointed an insolvency practitioner to begin liquidation, and the website stopped being updated.

Its old web address no longer belongs to a local news service. When we checked on 18 November 2026, pages on the old address were promoting gambling websites that operate outside GamStop, the scheme people use to block themselves from gambling sites. We recommend you do not use the old address, and that you update any link to it on your own website or social media.

If gambling is causing you harm, the National Gambling Helpline is free and open 24 hours a day on 0808 8020 133, or via live chat at gamcare.org.uk. You can block yourself from gambling websites licensed in Great Britain through GamStop, the free national self-exclusion scheme.

sections.heading: Community groups and clubs
sections.html:
Rochdale Online hosted free websites for hundreds of local clubs, churches and charities. Some of those sites have been moved to rochdalecommunity.org.uk.

If your group lost its page, Rochdale Daily will cover your news and list your events free of charge. Send us your story or email news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.

sections.heading: Old Rochdale Online articles
sections.html: Many old Rochdale Online pages were saved by the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine. If you cite one in research or on Wikipedia, link to the archived copy, not the live address.
